newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee mixed after March aims for high.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee mixed after March aims for high.

text.p: LIFFE coffee futures mixed after fund buyers again pushed towards resistance at $1,335 on March, traders said.

March's high of the day was $1,334, but it came back in the final minutes of trading to end unchanged at $1,330. March was the most active month, with 2,537 lots changing hands, out of a total of 6,018.
May was next most active, with 2,324 lots traded. The day's moves ranged between January, which last traded up $7 at $1,364 and November and January 1998, which both last traded down $7.
New highs in New York, despite a rise in U.S. stocks and news of an end to the Colombian dock workers' strike, helped encourage London, one trader said.
Columbian dock workers reached an agreement with cargo operators Thursday to end the strike, which has paralysed the Pacific coast port of Buenaventura, a port authority official said.
An increase in U.S. consumer stocks was announced after the close of the market on Wednesday.
